Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 2855/2023

Dear Ms. Menon,

Thank you for meeting us on 2 February 2024 about your dispute with Naveen Kulkarni. As we understand it, the neighbour has encroached on the boundary of the plot.

Our advice is to apply for a court commissioner to measure the boundary. Please collect the sale deed, the survey map and the land records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 58 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
